items.quote: the mode of payment is going to be the preferential share allotment, which will be non-convertible. Yeah. So, there will be some preferential share, and very minor cash transaction, not exceeding INR25 crores to INR30 crores

items.statement: IGX IPO process on track to reduce IEX holding from 47.3% to 25% by end of December 2026 per PNGRB regulations
items.quote: As per PNGRB regulations, (Petroleum and Natural Gas Board), we have to lower our existing holding from 47.3% to 25% by end of December 2026, and the IPO process remains on track.

items.statement: H1 FY27 operating cash flow was INR136 crores versus an outflow of INR101 crores in H1 FY26
items.quote: Most importantly, we generated INR136 crores of operating cash flow in H1, against an outflow of INR101 crores in H1 last year.

items.statement: Operating cash flow conversion was 58% of H1 PAT, well ahead of the earlier guided 20% OCF to PAT conversion
items.quote: H1 operating cash flow was INR136 crores, against the outflow of INR100.9 crores in H1 last year. This is 58% of H1 PAT, well ahead of the 20% OCF to PAT conversion we guided earlier.

items.statement: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flow
items.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

items.statement: Promoters committed to purchase land if no third-party buyer finalizes in 20-30 days; extended timeline to avoid related-party transaction
items.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase. But we intend not to be a related party transaction, that's why we have stretched one or two months.

items.statement: Merger with Sapphire Foods received CCI approval; awaiting SEBI no-objection and NCLT application; Sky Gate merger also progressing
items.quote: We are expecting that the merger should get approvals in line with our initial plans. You will be pleased to know that we have received CCI approval for the merger from the authorities.

items.statement: CCI approval received for Sapphire merger; awaiting SEBI no-objection to proceed with NCLT application; targeting merger closure by end of FY27
items.quote: As regards our proposed merger with Sapphire Foods, we are pl eased to mention that we have received the CCI approval on the merger last week. We are awaiting no objection from SEBI now

items.statement: Preferential issue of INR 200 crores at INR 26.4 per share was called off after stock price rose to INR 39; both debt and equity options remain open for future fundraising
items.quote: Yes, after the issuance was decided, and after the board was decided and the information given to th e exchanges, we received many calls from well -wishers and prospective investors, and they said that, “Why you are diluting so much at this price?” Means, INR 26.4 was the price as per the SEBI calculation

items.statement: Cash on balance sheet is Rs 4,676 Cr as of Q2FY27.
items.quote: The company also continues to be extremely well capitalised with Rs. 4,676 Cr of cash on the balance sheet.

items.statement: Management identified irregularities involving suspected employee collusion in a UAE subsidiary, leading to unauthorized bookings and an estimated net financial loss of Rs 8 crores.
items.quote: we had identified certain irregularities involving suspected collusion among some employees, which led to some unauthorized bookings made in some government travel agency account.

items.statement: Company received a FEMA adjudication order post quarter-end and plans to file an appeal; no provision made as legal advice indicates high chances of winning.
items.quote: Subsequent to again the quarter end, we have received the adjudication order, and based on the advice from our legal consultants, we would be going ahead and filing an appeal against the same.

items.statement: Management expects positive working capital impact to continue by end of FY27.
items.quote: Yes. overall, there are certain benefits that we are getting from the working capital per se in the business.

items.statement: Free cash flow for H1 FY27 was INR 45.5 crores after accounting for business acquisition, driven by healthy operating cash flow to EBITDA ratio of 69.2%.
items.quote: company had a free cash flow for H1 of INR45.5 crores after account for business acquisition driven by healthy operating cash flow to Akums Drugs & EBITDA at a ratio of 69.2

items.statement: Raised INR700 crores through QIP oversubscribed 1.5x in Q2 FY27
items.quote: In Q2 of FY '27, we also raised INR700 crores through QIP, which was over oversubscribed 1.5x.

items.statement: Receivable days improved from 179 in June 2026 to 150 in September 2026 on trailing 12-month basis
items.quote: On a trailing 12-month basis, our receivable days has improved from about 179 in June '26 to about 150 days in September.

items.statement: Operating cash outflow for H1 FY27 was INR12 crores versus INR37 crores for full FY26
items.quote: Operating cash outflow for the half was INR12 crores against INR37 crores for the whole year of FY26.

items.statement: Collected about INR50 crores after quarter closure; debtor days fell from 193 in March to 150 in September
items.quote: And we have collected about INR50 crores since this -- after closure of this quarte r. Our focus is now to bring debtor days further down

items.statement: Expect to receive entire INR190 crores trade receivables within next 6 months; received INR200 crores in H1
items.quote: Out of INR190 crores, entire INR190 crores we will be re ceiving in 6 months. In last quarter -- how much we have received last quarter? In H1, we have received INR200 crores

items.statement: Inventory buildup in H1 FY27 due to unbilled work-in-progress for NPCI and Bank of Abyssinia, unbilled redemption revenue, and unsold gift voucher inventory
items.quote: So, key reason behind this, like, inventory, it's actually divided into two parts. One is, the work in progress. And then one is inventory with us, right?

items.statement: Merchant promotion revenue billed after 30-45 days due to return/refund periods, contributing to unbilled inventory
items.quote: Third is redemption revenue, which was, Which, the redemption has happened, but, we haven't built it yet, right? So those are the three elements under which.

items.statement: AutoPay acquisition funded 20% via share swap, 40 crore from internal accruals and IPO proceeds, remaining 40-45 crore via preferential round by June 2027
items.quote: Some, around 20% off is through the, share swap, and then, rest of the, like, around 40 crore will be paid by, Our internal, accruals. Which are available in the company, and some IPO proceeds can be used for that as well. And, rest around 40 crore, 40 to 45 crore, or a little over then, depending on the market, which we are supposed to pay in June 2027. We are planning to do a pref round for that

items.statement: Operating cash flow turned negative despite strong PAT growth
items.quote: why did the operating cash flow turn negative despite strong PAT growth?

items.statement: Receivables increased by Rs. 24.38 crores, expected collection in October and current quarter
items.quote: Yes, we have raised the, we had the receivables for the last quarter also. And on the 31st March also, that also has been collected. And we have raised certain invoices. You can understand that over a period of time in the current financial quarter, in the last 15 days also, few projects have been delivered. Again, those projects, the invoices were raised in the last week, mostly in the last week

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative INR9 crores in H1 FY27 due to working capital absorption of INR10 crores
items.quote: H1 FY27 PAT we have recorded about INR5.09 crores and operating cash flow was negative for about negative INR9 crores. So working capital absorbed like INR10 crores in the period.

items.statement: Management expects operating cash flow to remain negative in H2 FY27
items.quote: So can we conclude that cash flow from operations is going to be like negative in H2 also? Sumit Bajaj: Yes.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased 80% YoY with aging of 90-120 days; expected to reduce in H2
items.quote: Our trade receivables increased by almost 80% on a Y-o-Y basis. So why is it so and like what is the aging of these trade receivables? Sumit Bajaj: See, normally our aging is between 90 to 120 days.

items.statement: Inventory levels were higher in H1 FY27 due to replenishment; expected to normalize next year
items.quote: In telecom segment, we service across the country, so we have to have inventory at almost, you know, every location. So that's why our inventory has been a bit higher side.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance is Rs. 535 crores as of September 30, 2026.
items.quote: Our cash and bank balance is strong at Rs.535 crores.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased to Rs. 674 crores from Rs. 456 crores due to milestone billing at quarter end.
items.quote: Trade receivable increased to Rs.674 crores from Rs.456 crores, primarily on account of milestone related billing towards the end of the quarter.

items.statement: Significant realization of receivables expected in Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We expect significant realization in Q3.

items.statement: Working capital days at 123 days vs 99 days previously; target to maintain 90-100 days.
items.quote: Working capital days stood at 123 days as compared to 99 days.

items.statement: Mobilization advance is Rs. 29 crores as of September 30, 2026, mostly interest-free.
items.quote: mobilization amount as on 30 th September, 2026 is just Rs. 29 crores. And mostly, the current one is without interest

items.statement: Completed IPO raising Rs. 258 crores via fresh issue; net worth increased to Rs. 1,276 crores.
items.quote: This quarter we completed our IPO and raised Rs.258 crores via fresh issue, net worth increased to Rs.1,276 crores as on 13th September, FY 2026, from Rs.893 crores in March FY 2026.
